raw.title: Hindu philosophy
raw.description: Philosophical traditions of Hinduism and the Vedas
raw.extract: Hindu philosophy or Vedic philosophy is the set of philosophical systems that developed in tandem with the first Hindu religious traditions during the iron and classical ages of India. In Indian philosophy, of which Hindu philosophy is a prominent subset, the word used for philosophy is darshan or darshana.
